comparison.objective: Fit a rubber stopper at least 12 mm onto a glass tube using the safe method.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold fragile tubing close to the joint while twisting and pushing the stopper on with the other hand.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper reaches depth and is released; working it without a nearby stabilizing grip is a latched unsafe failure.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization and lateral-load avoidance are shared, but this task tests safe interference-fit insertion; it has no hammer impulse, notch fracture, or fragment recovery.
